desc: Derive the fixed-\(k\) chain DP, including the exact local transfer savings.
Prove that longer forward changes are never better than deletion plus insertion, and account for the no-wrap `'z'` boundary.
Determine the enumeration range for \(k\), empty/all-deleted cases, zero-frequency letters, and already-good strings.
Implement `makeStringGood` with an efficient \(O(26n)\) algorithm for \(n \le 2\cdot10^4\).
Exhaustively validate the implementation against brute-force and adversarial/random cases.
